name: dsh-bg-plugin
description: Persistent full-window background for DeepSeek Harness: upload images and tune panel plate, opacity, brightness, mask, blur, position and fit. Images live on the host filesystem, so they survive browser data clearing and reinstalls.
author: huangfuren

scripts.check: node --check lib/index.js && node --check lib/storage.js && node --check lib/routes.js && node --check lib/multipart.js && node --check lib/image-format.js && node --check client/client.js && node scripts/check-manifests.mjs
scripts.test: node --test test/image-format.test.js test/multipart.test.js test/storage.test.js test/routes.test.js test/plugin-apply.test.js
